hero.title: Pool service
hero.lead: Houston pool resurfacing, remodeling, repair & new builds. Express Pool Plastering & Repairs brings tired pools back to life. Free quote.

summary: Express Pool Plastering & Repairs offers comprehensive pool replastering services, custom pool design and construction, and premium pool upgrades across Houston, Baytown and Pasadena.

groups.title: Comprehensive Pool Replastering Services
groups.summary: Give your existing pool a stunning makeover with our extensive renovation services.
groups.intro: Give your existing pool a stunning makeover with our extensive renovation services. Whether your plaster is showing signs of wear, your tiles are outdated, or your coping needs refreshing, Express Pool Plastering & Repairs handles every detail with precision.

groups.title: Custom Pool Design and Construction
groups.summary: Dreaming of a brand-new swimming pool or spa tailored to your specific vision?
groups.intro: Dreaming of a brand-new swimming pool or spa tailored to your specific vision? Beyond renovations, we excel in custom new pool and spa design and construction.

groups.title: Premium Pool Upgrades
groups.summary: Elevate your existing pool with our expert pool renovation services.
groups.intro: Elevate your existing pool with our expert pool renovation services. We specialize in sophisticated pool upgrades like custom pool decking, modern tile designs, and elegant water features. We can also install energy-efficient LED lighting to create a magical nighttime atmosphere.

groups.title: Reliable Pool Equipment and Parts
groups.summary: A great pool requires great equipment.
groups.intro: A great pool requires great equipment. We supply and install a full range of high-quality pumps, filters, heaters, and automation systems to keep your pool running smoothly and efficiently. Our swimming pool contractors can also handle any necessary repairs, ensuring your system is always in perfect working order.

about.title: About Express Pool Plastering & Repairs
text: No job is too large or small for Express Pool Plastering. Whether you need a simple plaster, tile, coping or decking repair, or a complete overhaul or redesign of your existing pool and spa, we will deliver spectacular results that suit your unique design style.

We offer installation of plaster, tile, coping, decking, water features, spas and much more. Our experienced designers and sales staff have the knowledge to assist you in planning your renovation with only the best materials.
